text:
# 阶段二：Playwright 脚本资产、独立验证与定时回归平台 v5.1

> 版本：5.1.0  
> PoC 依据：PoC-04 独立 Playwright 测试通过；PoC-05 六段 Cron、时区、禁止重叠和 Artifact 下载通过。

## 1. 目标

提供与 LLM/Midscene 解耦的确定性执行平面：

```text
Script Artifact Registry
Static Security Gate
Independent Validation Runner
Baseline Comparator
Schedule Registry
Regression Scheduler
Regression Runner
Artifact Delivery
Evidence/Audit/Notification
```

## 2. 工程结构

```text
apps/regression-test-portal/
services/test-control-service/
services/artifact-registry/
services/scheduler-service/
workers/validation-playwright-worker/
workers/scheduled-regression-worker/
packages/script-artifact-contracts/
packages/script-security/
packages/baseline-comparator/
packages/scheduler-contracts/
packages/platform-output-adapter/
```

## 3. ScriptArtifact

```json
{
  "artifactId":"SCRIPT-001",
  "caseId":"REG-PAY-001",
  "version":"1.0.0",
  "entrySpec":"tests/payment.spec.ts",
  "sha256":"...",
  "status":"SCRIPT_VALIDATED",
  "baselineId":"BASE-PAY-001",
  "environmentRef":"SIT",
  "fixtureProfile":"PAYMENT_STANDARD"
}
```

## 4. 静态门禁

```text
Manifest JSON Schema
TypeScript --noEmit
ESLint
AST Security
Import Allowlist
Secret Scan
URL Allowlist
Path Validation
Locator Quality
Fixture/Baseline Reference
Dependency Lock
```

禁止：

```text
eval/new Function
child_process
任意 fs 写入
任意 socket/network
硬编码 Secret
任意外部 URL
无限循环
未批准的坐标点击
```

## 5. 独立验证 Runner

```text
Validate Task
→ 独立 Worker 进程
→ 新 Fixture Namespace
→ 新 Storage State
→ 新 BrowserContext
→ 执行生成脚本
→ 采集 Trace/Screenshot/Network
→ Baseline Comparator
→ Cleanup
```

必须与 Replication Worker 完全隔离。

## 6. Baseline Comparator

source: background information/落地方案 V5.1/阶段二_Playwright脚本资产独立验证与定时回归平台_v5.1.md
text:
```json
{
  "comparisonId":"CMP-001",
  "status":"BASELINE_MATCHED",
  "checks":{
    "visibleTexts":"PASSED",
    "route":"PASSED",
    "outputs":"PASSED",
    "network":"PASSED",
    "businessState":"PASSED"
  }
}
```

截图比较只有在固定 OS、Chromium Revision、字体、Viewport、DPI、Locale、Timezone 和 Headless Mode 时启用。

## 7. Artifact Registry

存储：

```text
ZIP/TS 文件
Manifest
版本
SHA-256
验证状态
Baseline 结果
下载权限
保留期
```

接口：

```text
POST /api/v1/artifacts
GET  /api/v1/artifacts/{id}
GET  /api/v1/artifacts/{id}/download
POST /api/v1/artifacts/{id}:approve
POST /api/v1/artifacts/{id}:deprecate
```

## 8. Scheduler

六段 Cron：

```text
second minute hour day-of-month month day-of-week
```

```json
{
  "scheduleId":"SCH-001",
  "scriptArtifactId":"SCRIPT-001",
  "cron":"0 0 9 * * 3",
  "timezone":"Asia/Shanghai",
  "misfirePolicy":"DO_NOT_CATCH_UP",
  "concurrencyPolicy":"FORBID_OVERLAP",
  "environmentRef":"SIT",
  "fixtureProfile":"PAYMENT_STANDARD",
  "enabled":true
}
```

支持：

```text
创建、确认、暂停、恢复、删除
立即运行
下一次运行预览
周/月/Cron
禁止重叠
错过触发策略
失败通知
```

## 9. 原生 Trigger 与 Scheduler Adapter

统一接口：

```text
createSchedule
pauseSchedule
resumeSchedule
runNow
listRuns
```

实现：

```text
HiAgentScheduleAdapter
CozeScheduleAdapter
InternalSchedulerAdapter
```

租户能力不满足时自动使用内部 Scheduler，但 Agent 页面仍是管理入口。

## 10. Run 状态

```text
CREATED
→ QUEUED
→ PREPARING
→ RUNNING
→ COMPARING
→ PASSED | FAILED | TIMED_OUT | SYSTEM_ERROR
```

## 11. 失败分类

```text
PRODUCT_FAILURE
TEST_SCRIPT_FAILURE
ENVIRONMENT_FAILURE
FIXTURE_FAILURE
BASELINE_DRIFT
VISUAL_CHANGE
UNKNOWN
```

失败只创建 `ReauthoringRequest`，不得自动修改正式脚本。

## 12. Portal

```text
/scripts
/scripts/{id}
/schedules
/schedules/{id}
/runs
/runs/{id}
/baselines
/environments
/evidence
/approvals
/audit
```

## 13. 数据库

source: background information/落地方案 V5.1/阶段二_Playwright脚本资产独立验证与定时回归平台_v5.1.md
text:
```sql
CREATE TABLE script_artifact (
  id UUID PRIMARY KEY,
  case_code VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL,
  version VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL,
  storage_uri VARCHAR(1024) NOT NULL,
  sha256 CHAR(64) NOT NULL,
  status VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL,
  baseline_id UUID NOT NULL,
  created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  UNIQUE(case_code, version)
);

CREATE TABLE regression_schedule (
  id UUID PRIMARY KEY,
  artifact_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES script_artifact(id),
  cron_expression VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL,
  timezone VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL,
  concurrency_policy VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL,
  misfire_policy VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL,
  enabled BOOLEAN NOT NULL,
  next_fire_at TIMESTAMPTZ,
  created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
);
```

## 14. 审计事件

```text
SCRIPT_UPLOADED
SCRIPT_STATIC_VALIDATED
SCRIPT_INDEPENDENT_RUN_COMPLETED
SCRIPT_APPROVED
SCHEDULE_CREATED
SCHEDULE_PAUSED
SCHEDULE_TRIGGERED
REGRESSION_RUN_COMPLETED
ARTIFACT_DOWNLOADED
REAUTHORING_REQUEST_CREATED
```

## 15. Definition of Done

- 仅 `SCRIPT_VALIDATED` 可挂载；
- 独立 Runner 通过；
- Baseline Comparator 通过；
- 周、月、Cron 定时通过；
- 禁止重叠和时区正确；
- Artifact 下载和 Agent 返回入口可用；
- 正式运行不调用 LLM/Midscene；
- Evidence、通知和审计完整。
